research_question: What do middle-school students' ASSISTments skill-builder response patterns reveal about mastery of core mathematics skills - a cognitive diagnosis (DINA) analysis of skill mastery prevalence and item quality, with classical item analysis, using a skill-tag-derived Q-matrix?

filters: first attempt per (user_id, template_id) by min order_id
item_construction.q_matrix: one attribute per template = its skill tag (simple structure); attributes = the 8 skill names

target_population: ASSISTments 2009-10 skill-builder students meeting the scope floors
known_concerns_to_flag: PSY-09 Q-matrix is tag-derived, not expert-validated - named limitation
PSY-10 mastery reported as prevalence, never individual diagnosis
structural sparsity: matrix mostly empty by design; responses never imputed
no demographics in the public log: demographic fairness analyses are not possible and the paper must say so
